name: Computer Health Checkup
description: Run a comprehensive health check of the user's computer — system info, disk, network, battery, and running apps — to proactively identify issues
prompt: Run get_system_info, check_network, check_disk_health, get_battery_status. Present ONLY data returned by the tools — do not add specs or values you didn't get from tool output. Format as a report card with one line per category. If a tool fails or returns no data, say 'Could not check' for that category.
